about: Sky-to-sea links: which docks exist, in which realm, for which vessels, and which docks connect. Realm ids are the session ids from engines/unreal/DaedalusLink/Source/DaedalusLink/Public/DaedalusRealmSessionCore.h (WORLD-ZERO, OCEAN, ...). Checked by tools/ocean/links_check.py against those RealmDefs. Data only: no host loads this yet (DaedalusOceanTravelComponent::ConfigureHost is fed in code today; team-codex owns it).

anchor.source: hd_island manifest terraces[role=dock] + its sky-sea boat (hd_island.py buildings: dock)

docks.story: The rim dock under the waterfall lip. Sky-sea boats ride the falls' spray down to the Ocean pier; they float, they cannot fly (ADR-066).

anchor.source: design: the tide-pen shelf beside the pier (data/ocean/tidepen.json)

docks.story: A rock shelf of tide pools beside the pier, where sky-born sea creatures are cared for before anyone may pen them.

returns.rule: session core: OCEAN --shore--> the realm you sailed from
